title: PRF for Accelerating Palatal Healing
brief_summary: Backgroung: Various agents are used to reduce post-operative complications associated with palatal donor site surgery for free gingival graft (FGG) harvesting. This study was conducted to evaluate the effects of platelet-rich fibrin (PRF) on palatal wound healing.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* no contraindications for periodontal surgery;
* full-mouth plaque score of \<10%
* full-mouth bleeding score of \<15%.

Exclusion Criteria:

* previously undergone surgery for a graft harvested from the palate
* presence of systemic disease or taking medication known to interfere with periodontal health
* smokers
* possible coagulation disorders
